propositions: git stash operations in the tickets worktree pop stash entries created in other linked worktrees, because the stash stack is repository-global and shared across all worktrees
a foreign stash applied to the tickets worktree leaves the index in an unmerged stranded state with DU entries, blocking all subsequent store writes and corrupting source paths into the ticket branch
push.py performs stash-push, merge, and stash-pop to handle conflicted merges, but this design is unsound for linked worktrees and must be replaced with a non-stack-based mechanism
the tickets branch legitimately tracks no source code, so untracked source paths appearing in the index indicate pollution and should be auto-healed rather than refusing writes
rebar must provide a supported maintenance entrypoint with backup-before-write, refusal on unpushed commits, and audit logging as the only sanctioned way to perform raw git operations on the tracker
a break-glass override flag with explicit written reason is required for cases the supported entrypoint does not cover, and must be loud in output and durable in the audit record
